verdicts.reason: Both scramble the message into nonsense: 'PRAY' sits above 'When Life Is Great', 'When Life Is Rough' is shoved off-axis to the left, and the divider line is stranded at the bottom. On top of that, the rose is cut off into a hard-edged rectangle. A is worse: 'When Life Is Rough' butts up against the rose's cropped edge, and there's a wide dead gap on the left. B leaves a little more room between the text and the rose and balances the left side slightly better, but it still fails on reading order and alignment.
